issue_request: FHIR-5931 is a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core issue asking that the "Flags" column label in hierarchical resource/profile views be made a link because the separate help icon was not discoverable enough.
initial_application: The Jira comments record svn revision #4683 as the original application. No modern Git commit in this checkout explicitly mentions FHIR-5931 or svn revision #4683, but current source and rendered build output already show linked Flags headers.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes Resource and the current resource pages whose generated hierarchy tables are the relevant build surface. source/resource/resource-notes.xml and source/conformance-rules.html contain linked Flags hierarchy headers, while source/formats.html documents the Logical table and Key to Flags. Related Published issues FHIR-7220 and FHIR-7438 later addressed explanatory help/footer text for the same symbols and their comments treat the column-heading link as already present. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current built specification already provides the requested link on resource/profile hierarchy table headers; remaining plain "Flags" labels are explanatory examples, templates, or unrelated release/history surfaces rather than missed current hierarchy headers.
